scripts.install:all: cd shared && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build:all: cd shared && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "cd shared && npm run dev" "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.clean: rm -rf shared/dist backend/dist frontend/.next shared/node_modules backend/node_modules frontend/node_modules
